replace.note: written only when the replace field is present

batch_mode.note: registered directly in the definition table with the literal kCFBooleanTrue, i.e. it is a fixed flag of the 'find with list' action and not a per-cleaner setting; no accessor or writer seen.

list_name.note: default value is the empty string and it is present in saved cleaners, so it is a real per-instance setting; the writer has not been decompiled.

known_gaps: definition-table parameter lists are lower bounds: keys written through setParam*:forName: are constructed inside the callee and do not appear in the harvested literal set.

SingleAction factories are assembled from tables the tables' own literals do not repeat, so `define*Actions` names fewer action ids than it registers. Which body registers which id is not yet pinned down for more than a few ids.
no writer has been decompiled for list_name, so the 'find with list' path is described by name only (batch_mode is known to be a fixed true flag, not a setting).
